parameters.description_en:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the current instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID exists, you must specify it; otherwise, the invocation fails.</props>

<props="china">
> If your public instance does not have an ID, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>
parameters.description_zh:
实例ID。

<props="china">您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。</props>

<props="china">
> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>

parameters.description_en:
The project ID.
1. Log on to the [IoT Application Development Console](https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb). After selecting the target instance in the upper-left corner of the page, click Project Management in the left-side navigation pane.
2. In the standard project list, locate the target project, click its project card, and then check the address bar of your browser to find the project ID.
parameters.description_zh:
项目ID。
1. 您可登录[物联网应用开发控制台](https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb)，在页面左上角选择对应实例后，在左侧导航栏单击项目管理。
2. 在普通项目列表中，找到目标项目，单击项目卡片，在地址栏中查看。
